Keyboard shortcuts

Space
Play or pause
← →
Step one frame (hold Shift for 10)
1 / 2
Show only clip A or B; press again for both
F
Full screen: only the videos and drawings
L
Link or unlink the clips
P
Add a sync point
O
Overlay on or off
[ ]
Set loop start and end
S
Snapshot
R
Start or stop recording
Ctrl+Z
Undo the last drawing
?
This list
Esc
Close menus, leave full screen or single-clip view
